Design & digital identity for architecture studios.

Calm, considered brand systems and WordPress websites for architects, interior designers and developers — from the logo down to the last hover state. Simple, structural, quietly luxurious.

DisciplineUI/UX · Rebranding
PlatformWordPress · Figma
StatusOpen to work

What I deliver

A full identity-to-launch service. Every deliverable the brief mentioned — logos, buttons, e-cards, headers, footers, whole WordPress sites — treated as one coherent system.

Brand identity

Logo systems, monograms, colour, type scales and usage rules packaged as a tidy brand kit.

UI / UX design

Wireframes to polished interfaces — buttons, forms, navigation, states — designed in Figma, shipped clean.

WordPress build

Custom themes and block/Elementor builds: fast, editable by your team, and pixel-faithful to the design.

Collateral

E-cards, business cards, email headers, social templates and footers that hold the brand together.

Three brand studies

Three concept identities across the range of practices I design for. Each is a complete kit: logo, palette, type, buttons, an e-card, and a website header, hero & footer.

Profile

I'm a UI/UX & WordPress designer who treats a brand like a building — start with structure, keep it simple, and let the materials do the talking.

Omar Bader is a UI/UX & WordPress designer based in Beirut, Lebanon, working remotely with studios and brands abroad. He designs brand identities and builds fast, editable WordPress sites — a designer's eye paired with a developer's hands, so the live site matches the design down to the detail.

My process runs from brand and identity through to a live, editable WordPress site: research, wireframes, a design system in Figma, then a build the client's team can actually maintain.

FocusRebranding · UI/UX · WordPress
ToolsFigma · WordPress · Elementor · Adobe
BasedBeirut · Remote worldwide
LanguagesArabic · English

Available for freelance and full-time roles — remote or hybrid.
